<role>

</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

Customers report that a one-size-fits-all approach does not work, as some teams require manual control for complex cases while others need automated routing for speed and efficiency [i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12].\n\n## Who is affected\n- **High-volume motor teams** who find that manual claim routing slows them down too much and want automatic assignment based on postcode and workload for scaling [i:63e7d0c8fea46281].\n- **Specialty or commercial claims teams** who need manual control for complex cases, as their work is too complex for auto-routing [i:35df28f51fb00a24].\n- **Multi-team organizations** that require per-team configuration of routing rules to accommodate both automated and manual preferences, as forcing one approach across all teams does not work [i:2b8201db7ce2cec6][i:c8869934e9e77aad].\n\n## Evidence\n- The issue has been mentioned 7 times across 5 accounts [i:2b8201db7ce2cec6][i:35df28f51fb00a24][i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12][i:63e7d0c8fea46281][i:9bcfbf187a659dd5][i:c8869934e9e77aad][i:ec07f5c294ac850c].\n- Mentions came through 2 distinct routes: 3 via support and 4 via onboarding [i:2b8201db7ce2cec6][i:35df28f51fb00a24][i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12][i:63e7d0c8fea46281][i:9bcfbf187a659dd5][i:c8869934e9e77aad][i:ec07f5c294ac850c].\n- The total Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) for these accounts is 4830000.0 GBP [i:2b8201db7ce2cec6][i:35df28f51fb00a24][i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12][i:63e7d0c8fea46281][i:9bcfbf187a659dd5][i:c8869934e9e77aad][i:ec07f5c294ac850c].\n- **Saltmarsh Specialty** (ARR: 740000.0 GBP) states their motor team wants automatic routing but specialty handlers need manual control, requiring per-team configuration [i:2b8201db7ce2cec6]. They also note their motor claims team prefers automatic allocation for scaling [i:9bcfbf187a659dd5].\n- **Wexmoor Motor** (ARR: 1950000.0 GBP) reports their commercial claims are too complex for auto-routing and need manual routing, while motor claims can stay automated [i:35df28f51fb00a24].\n- **Tidewell Marine & Cargo** (ARR: 420000.0 GBP) states a one-size-fits-all approach does not work and prefers per-team configuration [i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12]. They also report their high-volume motor team is slowed down by manual routing and wants automatic assignment [i:63e7d0c8fea46281].\n- **Ravensgill Insurance** (ARR: 470000.0 GBP) needs per-team configuration as their motor team wants more automatic allocation but commercial prefers manual control [i:c8869934e9e77aad].\n- **Callowfield Auto Assurance** (ARR: 1250000.0 GBP) reports their motor teams push for automated routing, but commercial teams need manual routing, requiring configuration that varies by team [i:ec07f5c294ac850c].\n\n## Why now\n- There have been 0 renewals in the last 90 days, indicating a period of stable contracts where feature development could influence future renewal decisions [i:2b8201db7ce2cec6][i:35df28f51fb00a24][i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12][i:63e7d0c8fea46281][i:9bcfbf187a659dd5][i:c8869934e9e77aad][i:ec07f5c294ac850c].\n- Multiple key accounts with upcoming renewals have voiced this need, including **Callowfield Auto Assurance** (renewal 2027-03-31), **Ravensgill Insurance** (renewal 2027-04-30), **Saltmarsh Specialty** (renewal 2027-05-15), **Wexmoor Motor** (renewal 2027-06-30), and **Tidewell Marine & Cargo** (renewal 2027-07-31) [i:2b8201db7ce2cec6][i:35df28f51fb00a24][i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12][i:63e7d0c8fea46281][i:9bcfbf187a659dd5][i:c8869934e9e77aad][i:ec07f5c294ac850c].\n- The most recent mentions occurred in late October 2026, showing the topic remains current and active in customer conversations [i:2b8201db7ce2cec6][i:c8869934e9e77aad].",

response.content: {"critique": "I checked every factual claim against the cited insights and fact sheet. Counts (7 mentions across 5 accounts, 3 via support / 4 via onboarding, 2 routes) and total ARR (4,830,000 GBP) all match. Per-account ARR figures, renewal dates, quote paraphrases (e.g., Saltmarsh wanting per-team config, Wexmoor's commercial complexity, Tidewell's motor-team slowdown) and the '0 renewals in 90 days' claim all check out, with quotes accurately paraphrased and not presented verbatim. The 'late October 2026' recency claim is supported by the 2026-10-27 and 2026-10-28 insights, and no cited contrary evidence is omitted.", "verdict": "pass"}
